day: # The ELCA keeps the Revised Common Lectionary (data/readings/rcl.csv, named
# in tradition.csv) as Evangelical Lutheran Worship (2006) prints it.  These
# rows are where ELW differs, checked against the ELCA's yearly lists of
#   - the lesser festivals have their own readings;
#   - the Easter Vigil has twelve readings, and John 20 as its Gospel;
#   - New Year's Eve (not New Year's Day), the Vigil of Pentecost, the week
#     after Easter and Reformation Day have propers;
#   - on Easter Day the Gospel of the year comes before John 20, and on the
#     Second Sunday in Lent of Year A John 3 is read alone;
#   - after Pentecost the complementary series is printed first (the setting
#     reading_order), and the daily readings follow it alone.
# Rows of kind `omit` drop the RCL's rows that these replace.  The psalm
# refrains the lists give in parentheses are left out.

title: Easter Vigil
reading: Song of the Three Young Men 35–65
